theme: La casa de Obed-Edom — la casa y los muebles, tener y hay, la posesión, las preposiciones de lugar
storyThread: La casa de Obed-Edom (2 Samuel 6:10-11): el arca queda en la casa tres meses y Dios bendice la casa. L1 = la casa por dentro (re-pass de a0-u03 at A1); L2 = lo que la casa tiene (tener/hay); L3 = de quién es (posesión); L4 = dónde está cada cosa (preposiciones). La lámpara de la casa es la palabra (Salmo 119:105).
grammarTargets: hay vs está/están (existencial vs locativo) — re-pass a0-verbs + a1-u01, deepened
tener paradigm: tengo/tienes/tiene/tienen (tenemos deliberately out of unit — near-form budget; A1-U5/U8 own it)
possession: mi/tu/su/nuestro + de + mío (mío/mía agrees with the thing owned)
prepositions of place + de-phrases: debajo de, detrás de, delante de, cerca de, lejos de; junto a takes NO de
¿Cuántos hay? — closes the a0-u06 cuántos/cuándo listening trap
adjective agreement review on house nouns (limpio/limpia, blanco/blanca) — re-pass a0-u06 + a0-u03, no new ids
waveNotes: l1 (12) = the house itself: 7 byte-identical re-passes from a0-u03 at A1 difficulty + 5 new objects. Exactly AT the 12-per-page threshold (DEFECTS #18) — no split required; if the renderer's threshold is strictly-below-12, split 6+6. l2 (6) = hay vs tener in depth: 3 re-passes (hay, tengo, tienes) + tiene/tienen + cuántos; hear-choose only, no sprites. l3 (6) = possession: mi (re-pass a0-u01) + tu/su/nuestro/de/mío; mi/tu/su is the paradigm set, mi/mío and tu/tú never co-occur. l4 (10) = prepositions of place, all new; hear-choose with the say carrying the relation, no sprites in this wave. No wave exceeds 12. Wave 5 = adaptive replay from progress.misses (unchanged convention, not a key in this object — matches a1-u01).

words.caption: Tu casa
words.note: tu (possessive) vs tú (pronoun, a0-u01) differ by the accent only — same family as cómo/como (DEFECTS #20). Never in the same option set; tile-size distinctness is a Reviewer check.

words.say: Nuestro patio es grande.

qna.nearFormRule: Never in the same word-round option set: cómo/como, vivo/vive, cree/crece/creó, por qué/porque, muro/pared, mi/mío, tu/tú, tiene/tienen, tienes/tiene, en/entre, nuevo/nuestro. cuánto is NOT a pool id — never use it as a decoy (phantom decoy, DEFECTS #14).
